SELECT DATE_FORMAT(apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM repair_mgmt WHERE deleted=0
AND dorm_num like CONCAT('%', #{dormBuilding}, '%')
AND apply_time between #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT repair_type AS type, COUNT(1) AS count FROM repair_mgmt WHERE deleted=0
AND dorm_num like CONCAT('%', #{dormBuilding}, '%')
AND apply_time between #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
GROUP BY repair_type

SELECT repair_type AS type, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = #{completed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, ROUND(SUM(IF(status = #{completed}, 1, 0)) / COUNT(1),2) AS finishRate, FROM repair_mgmt WHERE deleted=0
AND apply_time between #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT dorm_num AS building, COUNT(1) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = #{completed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, ROUND(SUM(IF(status = #{completed}, 1, 0)) / COUNT(1),2) AS finishRate, FROM repair_mgmt WHERE deleted=0
AND apply_time between #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
